wordpress.mode: real WordPress, fresh SQLite database, mocked external HTTP

tests.test: Guest downloads require a real owner or administrator
Real local session validates, commits once, and denies another user
Standard media collection and single routes hide FileHub records
Forged PDF content is rejected even with legacy MIME toggle off
Quota reservations account for open uploads and remaining bytes
Legacy upload and R2 presign endpoints are retired
Users cannot increase their own quota
Private directory is outside document root; traversal cannot delete a sibling
Same-name uploads use distinct physical keys and honor rename setting
Invalid chunk index/size and missing uploads fail closed
Ordinary WordPress media is not a FileHub deletion target
Cloud HTTP 403 preserves DB record; 204 permits deletion
File list page two and server search include old records
Unlimited quota is zero and guest statistics are isolated
Profile/registration type errors produce 400 rather than PHP errors
Typed settings normalize extensions and reject arrays
Earlier updater errors are preserved and failed HTTP calls are cached
R2 multipart sends bounded native HTTP requests and verifies final size
Google folder cache is bound to account/parent configuration
Failed/cancelled sessions retain reservations until cleanup succeeds
Registration policy hook runs and unverified accounts cannot log in
Private legacy migration preserves content and removes public copy
Download counter increments atomically and all statistics use real SQL
Bad upload nonce is rejected by the actual route permission callback
Password changes explicitly require client session reload
Google resumable offset recovers a lost completion without creating a second file
Download staging reservations prevent unbounded parallel disk use
A lowered quota is rechecked before committing a previously reserved file
Partial attachment metadata is repaired idempotently before commit
Antivirus endpoints are restricted to explicit local services
WordPress editor capabilities cannot take over another members FileHub file
Retained trash files still count against real storage quota

HTTP delete removes physical and indexed file
ClamAV protocol malware result blocks publication
Rejected scanner file can be cancelled and cleaned
HTTP password change signals required session reload
Previous REST nonce is rejected after password session change
Reloaded session can immediately update profile
